title: Minimum R version required by a package and everything it needs (numeric version comparison)
source_relation: adapted to a closed world: formal-requirement versus full-closure reasoning from the registry's dependency-verification specs, scored against the pinned installed library
difficulty_hypothesis: A package's own Depends line understates the requirement of its dependencies; textual version comparison orders 4.10 before 4.9; base packages must not be followed; the result must be normalised to three components.

mcp_relevance.rationale: Version-requirement reasoning over a dependency closure is exactly what a package-metadata service could help with in the open world, but the scorer fixes the evidence to the pinned installed library, so MCP can at most cross-check metadata for packages whose installed and CRAN versions agree. Marked exploratory because the closed-world reduction removes the information advantage.
mcp_relevance.information_need: Each package's stated R requirement and its dependency closure.

pinned_evidence.oracle: breadth-first closure over read.dcf() and numeric component comparison of R (>= x) constraints
